title: The Blessed User of Dragon Pokémon
party_selection_rule: 5 vs 5 Party Selection (select your 5 designated Pokémon from your active party when prompted at battle start)
overview: Gym Leader Clair commands the subterranean magma halls of Blackthorn Gym with hybrid Dragon fusions built for colossal power, speed, and dragon mastery. Feraligatr/Gyarados leads with Intimidate and Dragon Fang-boosted Aqua Tails, but suffers a fatal 4x Electric weakness. Donphan/Dragonair sets Thunder Wave behind Sturdy, yet carries an immediate 4x Ice weakness. Glaceon/Kingdra brings 118 Special Attack with Ice Beam and Mirror Coat, punished by Fighting, Rock, and Steel strikes. Ariados/Charizard unleashes Flare Blitz and Outrage, but collapses before a catastrophic 4x Rock weakness alongside Electric and Ice vulnerabilities. Her ace Garchomp/Aerodactyl is a 560 BST physical sweeper pairing 113 Attack and 120 Speed with Dragon Dance, yet is completely destroyed by a fatal 4x Ice weakness. Defeating Clair and visiting the Dragon Shrine awards the Rising Badge, TM101 (Dragon Pulse), the Red String Hair Bow vanity hat, and 4 Premium Wonder Trade tickets.

roster.tactics: Physical wallbreaker with 118 Attack and Intimidate. Weak to Rock and crippled by a fatal 4x Electric weakness. Strike with high-speed Electric attacks like Thunderbolt or Discharge for an instant OHKO.

Bulky Ground/Dragon hybrid that spreads paralysis with Thunder Wave. Sturdy guarantees it survives any single fatal blow. Crushed by a devastating 4x Ice weakness; eliminate with multi-hit or successive Ice moves.

Dangerous special sweeper with 118 Special Attack and 100 Defense. Beware Mirror Coat against special attacks. Exploit its physical weaknesses to Fighting, Rock, and Steel with moves like Close Combat.
Dual offensive striker wielding Flare Blitz and Outrage. Traps foes with Spider Web. Punish its catastrophic 4x Rock weakness or exploit its Electric and Ice vulnerabilities for swift elimination.

Terrifying 560 BST ace with 113 Attack and 120 Speed. Boosts with Dragon Dance to sweep. Suffer a fatal 4x Ice weakness; a bulky Ice-type like Lapras easily absorbs a hit and retaliates with an instant 4x Ice Beam OHKO.

starter_strategies.bulbasaur: Lapras (Lv. 67) acts as the ultimate dragon slayer; STAB Ice Beam lands devastating 4x super-effective damage to vaporize Donphan/Dragonair and ace Garchomp/Aerodactyl instantly. Venusaur/Charizard (Lv. 68) anchors with Sleep Powder to shut down Dragon Dance setup, and burns Ariados/Charizard with STAB Flamethrower. Kingler/Primeape (Lv. 67) crushes Glaceon/Kingdra with STAB Close Combat. Gyarados/Arbok blunts physical strikes with Intimidate, while Alakazam/Weezing executes Ariados/Charizard with STAB Psychic.
starter_strategies.charmander: Alakazam/Raichu (Lv. 67) provides an effortless 4x super-effective OHKO against lead Feraligatr/Gyarados with STAB Thunderbolt! Lapras (Lv. 67) rotates into the duel core to fire devastating 4x STAB Ice Beams, destroying Donphan/Dragonair and ace Garchomp/Aerodactyl. Charizard/Venusaur (Lv. 68) incinerates Ariados/Charizard with Flamethrower. Primeape/Sandslash (Lv. 67) shatters Glaceon/Kingdra with Close Combat and hits Ariados/Charizard with 4x Rock Slide. Gyarados/Nidoking applies Intimidate support.
starter_strategies.squirtle: Jolteon/Sandslash (Lv. 67) leads with high-speed Discharge for an instant 4x super-effective OHKO on Feraligatr/Gyarados! Lapras (Lv. 67) rotates into the duel core to wall dragon strikes and delete Donphan/Dragonair and ace Garchomp/Aerodactyl with lethal 4x STAB Ice Beams. Blastoise/Fearow (Lv. 68) washes away fire threats with STAB Hydro Pump. Arbok/Primeape (Lv. 67) cuts physical attacks with Intimidate and breaks Glaceon/Kingdra with STAB Close Combat. Alakazam/Weezing eliminates Ariados/Charizard with STAB Psychic.
